grain_rationale: One source row is one hourly weather observation at one airport, so the grain is transactional. The profile reports row_count 13014 and duplicate_row_rate 0.0, so there are no exact duplicate rows for an identity tuple to absorb. No single profiled column is unique on its own (the largest distinct_count is 4341 on observed_hour_utc and 2178 on humidity_pct, both far below row_count 13014), so a column identifier is not available; the combination of airport_code (distinct_count 3) and observed_hour_utc (distinct_count 4341) spans 3 x 4341 = 13023 possible pairs against 13014 rows, which identifies a single observation line and is therefore declared as the derived identity observation_identity. No aggregation is required because each row already stands as an event in its own right.

fields.name: airport_code
fields.description: IATA code of the reporting airport, a label with distinct_values EWR, JFK and LGA and null_rate 0.0, used as the station dimension and as the first element of the observation identity.

fields.name: observed_hour_utc
fields.description: UTC timestamp of the weather observation, with null_rate 0.0 and samples such as 2013-01-01T06:00:00 through 2013-01-01T15:00:00 that land on exact hours, so it timestamps each event at hour resolution between min 2013-01-01T06:00:00 and max 2013-07-01T03:00:00.

fields.name: observed_date_local
fields.description: Local calendar date of the observation, with distinct_count 181 spanning min 2013-01-01 to max 2013-06-30 and null_rate 0.0; it labels the observation by local day rather than timestamping it, so it is a dimension alongside the single time field.

fields.name: observed_hour_local
fields.description: Local hour of day as an integer label with min 0, max 23, distinct_count 24 and null_rate 0.0; it is a cyclical bucket that is grouped by rather than added, so it is a dimension.

fields.name: temp_f
fields.description: Air temperature in degrees Fahrenheit, a continuous quantity with min 10.94, max 93.92, distinct_count 130 and null_rate 0.0 that is averaged and compared across observations.

fields.name: dewpoint_f
fields.description: Dewpoint temperature in degrees Fahrenheit, a continuous quantity with min -9.94, max 73.94 and null_rate 0.0 that is compared and averaged across observations.

fields.name: humidity_pct
fields.description: Relative humidity as a percentage, a continuous quantity with min 12.74, max 100.0, distinct_count 2178 and null_rate 0.0 that is averaged across observations.

fields.name: wind_dir_degrees
fields.description: Compass bearing of the wind in degrees, nullable with null_count 219 and null_rate 0.016828 where direction was not reported, and stored on a 10-degree grid (samples 0, 10, 20 ... 90 with distinct_count 37 between min 0 and max 360), so it labels a direction rather than being summed.

fields.name: wind_speed_mph
fields.description: Sustained wind speed in miles per hour, a continuous quantity with min 0.0 and max 1048.36058 that is averaged and compared across observations; it is nullable with null_count 2 and null_rate 0.000154 for two observations that carry no wind reading.

fields.name: wind_gust_mph
fields.description: Peak wind gust in miles per hour, a continuous quantity with min 16.11092 and max 62.14212 that is compared across observations; it is nullable with null_count 9702 and null_rate 0.745505 because gusts are only recorded when the wind gusts at all.

fields.name: precip_inches
fields.description: Precipitation accumulated in the observation hour in inches, an additive quantity with min 0.0, max 1.06, distinct_count 50 and null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: pressure_mb
fields.description: Barometric pressure in millibars, a continuous quantity with min 983.8, max 1038.4 and distinct_count 430 that is averaged and compared; it is nullable with null_count 1496 and null_rate 0.114953 where the station reported no pressure.

fields.name: visibility_miles
fields.description: Reported horizontal visibility in miles, a continuous quantity with null_rate 0.0 reported on a fixed ladder of 20 distinct values from min 0.0 to max 10.0 that is averaged and compared across observations.

fields.name: airport_name
fields.description: Full name of the reporting airport, a descriptive label with null_rate 0.0 and distinct_values John F. Kennedy International Airport, LaGuardia Airport and Newark Liberty International Airport.

fields.name: airport_municipality
fields.description: Municipality the airport serves, a label with null_rate 0.0 and distinct_values New York and Newark.

fields.name: airport_elevation_ft
fields.description: Field elevation of the airport in feet, a static station attribute with only 3 distinct_values (13, 18, 21) and null_rate 0.0 that describes the station rather than measuring the observation.

fields.name: airport_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Length of the airport's longest runway in feet, a static station attribute with only 3 distinct_values (7002, 11000, 14511) and null_rate 0.0 that labels the station rather than measuring the observation.

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: Ingestion capture timestamp with null_rate 0.0 and only 3 distinct_values between 2026-09-02T23:26:11 and 2026-09-02T23:26:13, reflecting the load batch rather than the weather event, so it is carried as a lineage dimension and not as the time field.

category_description: One row is one hourly weather observation taken at one New York area airport: the station identified by airport_code and its descriptive attributes, the local date and hour labels, and the measured conditions (temperature, dewpoint, humidity, wind speed and gust, precipitation, pressure and visibility) for the hour stamped by observed_hour_utc.
purpose: This mapping declares how the contracted silver table silver.silver_airport_weather enters the gold unified event star as the airport_weather_observations fact category: which column timestamps each event and at what grain, which columns are dimensions and which are measures, and the degenerate identity (airport_code plus observed_hour_utc) that makes one observation line addressable. Its consumer is the deterministic modeling engine, which reads the mapping contract and emits the gold models; no table, view or transformation is declared here.
usage: The proposal is rendered into an ODCS mapping contract draft, validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema, gated by the validator and datacontract lint, and reviewed and edited by a human before approval. Once approved, the modeling engine reads it to generate the gold fact and its conformed dimensions; downstream analysts join the category on airport_code and the time field for hourly weather context, and roll up to local date through observed_date_local.
limitations: The mapping names silver columns and assigns roles only; it declares no quality rules, severities, classifications, service levels, ownership or access policy, and it filters nothing. It does not reconcile nullability: wind_gust_mph is absent for 74.5505 percent of rows, pressure_mb for 11.4953 percent and wind_dir_degrees for 1.6828 percent, so excluding or imputing those observations is left to consumers. It does not correct implausible values such as the wind_speed_mph maximum of 1048.36058 mph, and it does not deduplicate or reconcile airport_code with observed_hour_utc beyond declaring that pair as the identity; the profile shows duplicate_row_rate 0.0 but uniqueness of the identity tuple is not asserted by the mapping. It also leaves the UTC-to-local relationship between observed_hour_utc, observed_date_local and observed_hour_local unverified, and carries captured_at only as load lineage, not as an event time. Coverage is limited to the profiled window of 13014 rows from 2013-01-01T06:00:00 to 2013-07-01T03:00:00 across three airports.
